QuestInfo.name: [LINE FRIENDS] Snapshot Safari
QuestInfo.0: Can you believe today is the third and last photo shoot? Get your cameras and your defenses ready to take the perfect shots of #bMaple World's Famous Monsters#k!
QuestInfo.1:
Snap 3 pictures of Maple World's most notorious monsters for CONY. It looks like the camera she gave you is an older model, so the flash takes #b5 minutes#k to charge back up after taking a photo.
Her only guideline is to not take more than one picture of the same monster on a given day, so put on your hiking shoes and get out there where the wild things are!
QuestInfo.2: You delivered 3 pictures of #bfamous monsters#k to CONY and received a LINE FRIENDS Gift Box. What could be inside? Hopefully not bees.
